APR, lease, price, subscription and other offer text was observed on 2026-09-28 and may change. The draft routes shopping actions to Tesla's official site.
Rendered side-by-side comparison of the published desktop and mobile draft remains pending; exact visual parity is unverified.

published_asset_strategy: The two FSD videos load from their observed first-party Tesla CDN URLs; captured original files and hashes remain in the source record but are omitted from the hosted package to fit the Sites size limit.
